name: ListedDerivative
description: A securitized derivative on another asset.

deliveryTerm.description: Also called contract month or delivery month. However, it's not always a month. It is usually expressed using a code, e.g. Z23 would be the Dec 2023 contract, (Z = December). For crude oil, the corresponding contract might be called CLZ23. Optional as this can be uniquely identified in the identifier.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

instrumentType.description: Identifies the type of an instrument using an enumerated list.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

optionType.description: The type of option, ie Put or Call. Left empty if it is a Future.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

strike.description: Specifies the strike of the option.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.
